metadata.name: DELTARUNE Compatibility Merge
metadata.description: Compatibility merge of Custom Difficulty, Better Saves, Deltarune 60 FPS, Chapter 1 Modernized, No-Hat Ralsei, and New ACTs in the Knight Fight. Hotfix 1.0.7 expands spr_bhero_graze by two transparent bottom rows in Chapters 2-4 so its heart point is no longer clipped, while preserving the sprite origin and screen position. Includes all earlier fixes and the user-supplied Pink Fight music override.
